REQUEST
Write one text-to-image prompt for an empty sunlit stone courtyard with a dry fountain, ivy on the walls, and closed wooden doors. No people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures may appear. Return only the prompt and do not add a negative-prompt field.

OUTPUT A
A wide, sunlit view of an empty stone courtyard centers on a plain, unadorned dry fountain with a visibly waterless basin, surrounded by weathered paving, ivy-covered walls, and closed wooden doors. Warm daylight reveals rough stone textures and casts crisp architectural shadows; the entire scene contains only architecture and vegetation, with no people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures.

OUTPUT B
An empty stone courtyard bathed in warm sunlight, with a dry stone fountain and a visibly waterless basin. Green ivy climbs the textured stone walls, and every wooden door is firmly closed. Sunlight reveals weathered paving and natural wood grain. The entire scene is unoccupied, with no people, animals, statues, silhouettes, or reflections of figures anywhere.

CRITERION C05-OUTPUT (hard)
